checks.hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] A +-0.18 s window around v7's cuts is too narrow for slow or sparse songs (corrido, 78 BPM trap); a beat-grid snap or a wider window with an owner-approved limit would put every word on a hit without visibly changing the choreography.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: Some word cuts do not land on a hit when a song has no onset near the approved cut.
implementation: Snap to the strongest onset or tracked beat within +-0.25 s, keep >= 0.5 s between cuts, and show the owner a frame-numbered comparison against the approved timing before rendering.
use_when: Re-cutting an approved motion piece to new music.
avoid_when: The approved timing itself was the brief (exact copy of a reference).
checks.acceptance_test: At least 14 of 16 cuts on a detected onset or beat with no cut moved more than 8 frames from v7; owner review of the contact sheets.

checks.evidence: Measured on the delivered MP4s with ffmpeg ebur128: integrated -14.0 LUFS in all 8; true peak -2.4 (song 1), -4.6 (2), -1.6 (3), -1.3 (4) dBTP. Fades 0.03 s in, 0.25 s out (cosine). alimiter at -1.6 dBFS, 4x oversampled, engaged only for songs 3 and 4.

Each video differs in cover order and repeated covers (seeded shuffle), initial wheel angle (-0.50..+0.45 rad), wheel speed before the stack (x0.97..x1.04), wheel position (+-0.05 world units on a radius of 2.0) and scale (x0.97..x1.03), word entrance (y 20-32 px, tilt -4.5..+3.5 deg, from 0.83-0.87, 0.14-0.18 s), word and brand x, and cut times per song (table in README.md). Mean grey-level difference between same-theme videos over frames 45-135: 23-29 / 255; against v7: 26-30. 01-c1-negro keeps v7's word entrance values; it differs through covers, angle, position and cut times.

Stack track values (t >= 3.46 s) untouched in all rows. contact-sheets/stack-frames-107-131-all.png: v7 and the 8 videos at 3.57/3.77/3.97/4.17/4.37 s all show a full, level, parallel rolodex stack that clears at the same time as v7. Ring occupancy over frames 46-103 correlates 0.91-0.99 with v7.

Ground #F3F1EC (warm paper white), ink #0C0C0C, fine print #0C0C0C at 60 %, pill ink-on-ground inverted automatically through the v7 CSS variables. White-ground covers keep a visible edge against #F3F1EC (frames 119-128). Proposal by the agent; owner review pending.

End card moves keep v7's speeds and run to the last frame of the longer films (headline zoom to 1.02 + 0.015 per extra second, lower block 14 px and brand 3 % per 1.7 s). Mean per-pixel change in the text area over the last two frames: 0.08-0.39 in every video.

Inherited from approved v7: Free* lasts 0.87 s and Storage cuts in 0.83 s later, so both words are on screen for 1-2 frames (v7 frames 91-92; visible at 3.00 s in 05-c3-negro). Kept in all 8 to stay faithful to the approval; reported to the owner.
checks.hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] The overlap is an authoring slip in v7 (w2 duration not updated when the cut moved), not a design choice; the reference cuts cleanly.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: Two centre words share frames at a cut.
implementation: Derive each word's clip duration from the next cut (W2_OVERLAP = 0) and check frame by frame that exactly one word is visible.
use_when: Sequential centre words on hard cuts.
avoid_when: A deliberate cross-fade between words is part of the brief.
checks.acceptance_test: No frame with two centre words in any rendered video; owner confirmation that the clean cut is wanted.
